messages.subject: D-RUG and Other Events this week
parts:
Hi D-RUGies!

We have quite a bit going on this week.

There will be D-RUG at from 10am-noon virtually and in person, as well as Tea Time at 1pm and Co-working from 2-4pm. HOWEVER, All of those events will be in Library 362 (the conference room) instead of in the classroom.

This is because DataLab is running a Intro to Remote Computing Workshop this Thursday and Friday. If you have ever thought "this R code is taking a really long time to run. There must be a better way" or maybe "I ran out of memory again!", this is the workshop for you. You will need to have some familiarity with the command line for this workshop, but don't worry DataLab has you covered there as well with the Intro to Unix Command Line reader.

If you need more computing resources, but the command line seems a bit to scary, we have Using Campus HPC for Large Scale Data Analysis with OnDemand. This workshop is next Monday (December 18) and will show you how to use high performance computing resources from the comfort of an RStudio interface.

Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Happy Coding!
Your CooRdinators
